profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer, Staff SDET, Python Automation
profile.summary: 11+ years of experience, Magic Leap leadership, Google Gemini/Mobly work

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a small engineering team developing and maintaining 200+ Python automated tests across ML2 Core and Wearable Core suites for CI execution; assigned development tasks during weekly meetings and provided technical guidance. 
- Enhanced existing TestRail reporting integration for standalone Core and Wearable Core tests, building Python requests API calls to update test statuses and upload device logs and screenshots when relevant. 
- Implemented up to five retries for unsuccessful HTTP POST requests and error handling for connection failures and invalid or nonexistent test-case/run combinations. 
- Advised management during test planning and requirements reviews on automation feasibility, implementation constraints, and technical limitations; supported ML1/ML2 boot troubleshooting and recovery flashing.

positions.title: Google Client Engagement (Google XR Engineer)
positions.description:
- Developed reusable Gemini helper utilities and integrated them with the Mobly framework to support Gemini-related Python tests.
- Developed CI-integrated Python tests for Google hardware, investigated input-event and Gemini behavior issues, and conducted formal code reviews to improve automation quality.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer Test
positions.description: - Developed requirements-based and edge-case test cases for ML1 and ML2 hardware system validation.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description: - Presented QA Core Team testing activities and technical findings to partners and contractors.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description: - Developed automated scripts and performed design verification testing for Ford SYNC automotive voice-recognition systems in North American and European markets.

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description: Teach and tutor students in reading and mathematics from grade levels 2 through 12.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Distributor of photovoltaic system components and provider of photovoltaic system solutions.; Designed schematics for solar PV systems for off grid and on grid implementation.
Worked under senior electrical engineers in designing PV systems to meet customer needs.

positions.title: Student REU
positions.description:
Constructed modeling application for determining ideal drain current solutions for Field Effect Transistors (FET).
Tested hydrogen sensitivity effects of Gallium Nitride High Electron Mobility Transistors (GaN-HEMT) with varying temperature
and hydrogen concentration.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Tested switching characteristics of MOSFET/IGBT transistors for implementation in Crowbar effect for protecting power supply and
loads.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed procedures to be followed for replacing the current strip chart recorders at the Mission Control Center, thus establishing the
Systems Engineering Management Plan.
Designed 3-Dimension visual launch base, using 3DSMAX ver.7.5, for a prototype of the Crew Exploration Vehicle (CEV).

positions.title: Electrical Engineer Intern
positions.description:
National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA); Acquired data (such as fossil fuel plants, particulate matter emissions, etc.) for the DEVELOP program’s Tennessee Air Quality Team
located at Langley Research Center.
